reviews.text: Bear went to the clinic for an ear infection, he was a bit slow and barely ate, now he is back to himself and an adventure to give him his medicine.

Great experience overall The assistant that attended us was very nice and I loved the way she cared for my fat boy. The dr that I saw for the first time was amazing I always asked for the female but the male dr was great too . Thank you guys for making again my visit great
They are always great with my dog. They make sure he is up to date on everything to keep him healthy.
Everything was clean. The appointment was on time, and the doctor's care was excellent. I would recommend him.
We got the annual vaccinations and his flea and tick script at this appointment He's a15+ lbs cat that doesn't like to be messed with. Dr. Toledo takes good care of him.
Outstanding service provided

I had a wonderful experience bringing my cat, Jack, to Homestead Animal Hospital. The entire team from the front desk staff to the veterinary technicians and doctor was incredibly gentle, welcoming, and compassionate. They took great care of Jack, making sure he was comfortable throughout the entire visit. It's a huge relief to find a clinic that truly cares about pets and provides such top-notch service at a reasonable price. Highly recommend them to anyone looking for great vet care!
Hi, Roxanela. Great to hear that you had a good experience at Homestead Animal Hospital. We really appreciate you taking the time to share!

The staff here are all great. From the front desk and the vet techs to Zach and all the doctors, they truly care about your furry family member.  Dr. Toledo is the BEST.  I really miss Dr. Green, but Dr.  Toledo is doing very well filling his shoes.
Thank you so much for sharing your great experience with us, Chelsea !
Took my GSD in for a chronic ear infection and two days later he is 100% better!
Great service
Thank you for taking the time to rate us, Nanette! We are delighted that you had a great experience with Homestead Animal Hospital .

The visit was amazing. My 14-year-old baby has a mast cell tumor and was in pain. Lissette, the nurse, is the best in the world. She is so knowledgeable and kind. She was a light that brightened my day during such a difficult time.

I was devastated to see my 14-year-old baby suffering, but Lissette treated us with so much compassion. She took the time to explain everything to me and answered all of my questions.

I felt a great sense of relief after the visit. I am truly grateful for her kindness, compassion, and exceptional care. She made a very difficult day feel a little easier. ❤️
Your feedback is highly appreciated, Pavel. Thank you so much for the review!
Great office! They love my fur baby  and she loves everyone there.
Excellent nurse (Lizette)
Hi, Sharon. We appreciate the rating. So glad we could provide you with a positive experience at Homestead Animal Hospital!
Maverick and Simba enjoyed themselves and had fun. They also smelled very fresh and clean!

Excellent service and caring staff. Anais and Dr. Emond gave my paw baby the best attention and care. Highly recommend them for your paw babies!!! The doctor even checked in with me the following day to see how my baby was feeling.
Super nice my dog was in diarrhea. They took me in as a walk-in but right away and now my dog is feeling a lot better.

This vet canceled on me twice when I tried to refill my dog's epilepsy meds causing them to run out (resulting in an increase in seizures). When I was finally seen, days later, they had the nerve to lecture me on why I shouldn't let my dog's meds run out. Are you serious?  These people are rude and overcharge for poor service.

I had an appointment with the Hospital and they cancelled my appointment.
The I was told to go online to make another appointment.
The Hospital should have called me and make the new appointment.

I have been coming to Homestead Animal Hospital for 3 years now with 5 of my babies. My oldest cat who is 7 has been on and off sick for over a year now. I have spent a lot of time and money on many visits to HAH. I am disappointed that after over a year, we are no closer to any improvements and results. It seems like each time we go, they seem confused about how to treat her and recommend a wide variety of things that don't make sense to what she needs - which is antibiotics. They offer me ridiculously expensive estimates for things that she does not need. On my last visit, they would not give her vaccines even though they told me to come back for the vaccines, they refused to give her antibiotics, they didn't do the requested nail trim, and they still charged me almost $90 - for doing nothing. I am happy to pay for the quality care of my cat, but HAH does not seem reasonable.

I felt much more secure in the hands of Dr. Greene. I feel like since he passed, HAH has gone downhill. One time we were waiting in the packed waiting area, 2 hours passed our appointment time, and a dog literally died on the floor because HAH could not make the poor woman and her dog a priority. It was traumatizing for the woman and for the others waiting with their pets. If they are packing in visits and not accounting for time in the day for emergencies and other things that come up, then they will always be overwhelmed. I hope they can figure out ways to make improvements for the people that go there, but I will be taking my animals elsewhere for better quality care and overall a better experience.
I recently adopted a rescue pup. The staff has been so friendly and patient with him. Although my boy is a bit crazy, they always have something nice to say.
Jason and the team were amazing!
Very happy with their customer service. Dr. Toledo was very thorough and caring for my senior dog. The vet tech was awesome.

Our dog half the way and they were very, very comforting and also help me understand the process for my animal's cremation, they even offered a little room to say good by and spend 510 minutes with your love. Animal

I was told I would get pictures of my pet daily, but I only got one picture out of 3 dauys.  Also, I wish they would place live cams where the pets are staying to look at the operation live.  Many other pet resorts offer this service.  It should provides the clients a piece of mine.
Jordan was our vet tech and she was amazing. My rescue dog had never been to a vet so was very scared. She made him so comfortable and ended with a pup cup. Love this place
Excellent service as Always. Very compassionate staff.
Thanks Ana for your professionalism and help. 👍🏽 We will be back!

After being a client of Dr. Toledo’s for over 20 years, I transitioned my pets to Homestead Animal with him. This practice is very clean, welcoming, and organized. I also bring my senior dog to Dr. Salazar when he’s available. He’s very kind, patient, caring, and communicative. The front staff is always welcoming and the techs are very compassionate. Vivi has taken care of me and my Boston Terriers for years now and she’s a true gem. I’m a very anxious client when my dogs have procedures and she’s just the most calming and comforting soul. Glad to bring my pets here for great care 🐾🩷

I had a very disappointing experience at Homestead Animal Hospital.
During Nathan's first visit, he was prescribed medication that I did not feel he needed, so I never filled the prescription.
On his second visit, I brought him in because he had a cough. Nathani is only four months old . The veterinarian prescribed antibiotics and cough medicine in pill form. Because he was so young, giving him pills was very difficult, so I spent the entire day calling the office and speaking with the reception staff to request a liquid version of the medication.
After multiple phone calls, I was finally given a liquid antibiotic prescription, but I was charged an additional $84 50 for the new prescription. I was also given a prescription for the cough medicine with an incorrect pharmacy phone number, which caused even more frustration and delays.
I felt that communication was poor, my concerns were not handled efficiently, and charging me again to change the medication to a liquid form was unfair. Overall, I am very dissatisfied with my experience and will not be returning.
Hopefully, this feedback helps improve communication and customer service for future pet owners.
❤️ Nathan's mom 🐕

Have been taking our (2) German Shepherds to Homestead Animal Hospital since they were (8) weeks old and our family loves the place. The staff is very friendly and it is very clean and organized. The Doctors and Technicians are very experienced and highly knowledgeable. Which is of the upmost importance.
Most of all, ONYX and LOKI love going there. They’re the first to jump in the truck.
Will highly recommend to my friends.
Hi, Armando. We appreciate the rating. So glad we could provide you with a positive experience at Homestead Animal Hospital!
Take my large dog here for boarding and Dr. Visits, the staff is awesome and very friendly. I know my 4 legged companion is is great hands here
Homestead Animal Hospital is great anddr toledo outstanding
Excellent service

Be prepared to wait 60-90mins every time. It’s ridiculous. That I take my dog here every time with an “Appointment” and at the end, they always made me wait for an answer, but it’s ridiculous cause why do I have to wait more than an hour and a half every time? Then when I wanna leave and I asked him to call me with the results cause I have things to do after one hour and 30 minutes they told me that they don’t know if they’re gonna be able to call me today or tomorrow so I have an appointment for nothing basically. Also every time I take my pet here she always ends up with something new, and they haven’t even found the right doses of medicine they need to give her. And she has been going to this vet 3 times in a row already.
Excellent service
The staff there is great and loving.
Love when I board my dog here.Sam is the best!!!! She gets my dog !!!
The staff and doctor are amazing, they treated my puppies with so much grace. Very helpful and knowledgeable team.
This is an amazing office. The vet is amazing and I will be my forever vet.

Great staff! Dr. Toledo listen to my concerns, and I didn't feel rushed. If you love your pet Homestead Animal Hospital is the place to go. You will receive the care and attention that you expect. These people are genuine.
Very happy with homestead animal hospital good take care  and recommended  ( CARLOS KITCHEN & VANITIES CORP )

This is not the same place where I took my beloved dog, Chip, to be taken care of, to be sheltered when we were away and ultimately put to sleep once his age was causing him pain and suffering. We took our new pup, Teddy, and initially everything was okay and we sheltered him there one time and he came back traumatized. I didn't think anything of it until now that I see how much this clinic's philosophy has changed. I am not the only one who sees this, there's other reviews denoting the same. This place has turned away our dog for emergency visits twice. This never would've happened before, and i am now grateful that they did because it showed me who they truly are and i am left to wonder how my pup was treated in their care when he was left alone. I will no longer take my dog here and will  no longer recommend this clinic to any of my neighbors or friends as i have for the past 10 years.
Side note: Dont purchase the careplan, it's just a way to get your money up front and deny you afterwards, it wasnt worth it in my opinion.
Very expensive.
Excellent service. Friendly and attentive staff.
Clean and professional. My(Onyx) Batman and (mellow) Minnie had a great experience..fast and clean
Very professional, staff is excellent. Excellent team. Walk me trough the surgery process for my dog with support and confidence

Met Dr. Ortega for the 1st time today and it was an EXCELLENT 1st time meeting!! Dr. Ortega was very pleasant, took her time examining my 2 fur babies and gave a thorough explanation of her recommended treatment plan for them. She answered all the whys, whats and ifs. The other staff members I encountered were friendly (as they always are).
The one thing I can complain about is the examining room we were in had clumps of dog hair all over the floor.
Really good service. My dog is really happy everytime we go!!!

My dog got sick suddenly I took him over there and they help me I will be always grateful.. they save him.. he was vomiting blood and popping blood it was a mess.. thanks to them I have my dog ..it was a very scary experience and they give me the support I needs at that time
Hi, Brenda. We appreciate the rating. So glad we could provide you with a positive experience at Homestead Animal Hospital!
We were vacationing when we needed Vet care. Homestead Vet was trustworthy and provided exceptional care.
Hi, Koda. Great to hear that you had a good experience at Homestead Animal Hospital. We really appreciate you taking the time to share!

I went to Homestead Animal Hospital for the first time today and I can't say enough about their team, everyone there was amazing, loving and understanding. Our visit was not a happy one but their team really supported us the whole way through. Thanks again to all of you for your truly amazing work and professionalism.
Amazing staff and quality doctor.. never tried to push you into getting anything that wasn't needed. Will be making this place my dogs permanent vet !

I cannot justify the pricing at this veterinary hospital. While the service may be acceptable, the costs are unreasonably high. I've taken my previous pet to multiple clinics in Doral for ear and stomach issues and never paid anywhere near what I was charged here. It's especially disappointing because this location is supposed to be more affordable than clinics in Midtown or other areas, yet it's significantly more expensive. I would not return based on pricing alone.

Thank you so much for sharing your great experience with us, Laurinda !
Great place with great people.

Unfortunately, my dog ​​didn't make it; she was very sick. But I am extremely grateful for the treatment and respect I received from the staff. They were understanding and gentle with my suffering and pain!
Very good vet Doctor Ortega is wonderful to both of my dogs.

A new company purchased Homestead Animal Hospital as a result of a terminal illness of the long term owner, Dr. Green.  My recent visits in January and March of 2026 have been very positive with excellent attention to the needs of our little family member (a 7 year old active Morkey). Good to see that Zack is back managing the clinic. I would highly recommend this Vet.

They brought us in for the 2nd check up only to tell us our dog needed surgery when two weeks prior to this on our initial visit these people VERBALLY ASSURED us that he would NOT need it & that he would heel QUICKLY and promptly SPECIALLY cause he’s a puppy.

But Mr. Jose Toledo’s team and staff misrepresented their statements as professionals,

These practitioners call themselves an ANIMAL EMERGENCY HOSPITAL , but after they lure you in,  all of a sudden they are a CORPORATION.

In the United States, vets recite the Veterinarian’s Oath when they graduate from veterinary school. It’s established by the American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA).

The oath typically includes commitments to:
•	Protect animal health and welfare⭐️

•	Prevent and relieve animal suffering⭐️

•	Promote public health⭐️

•	Advance medical knowledge⭐️

•	‼️Practice with conscience, dignity, and ethical responsibility‼️

ETHICAL RESPONSIBILITY !!!!

I’m guessing in Mr. Jose Toledo’s (HOMESTEAD ANIMAL HOSPITAL) case ETHICAL isn’t CORPORATE or vice verses. Cause that’s all they kept telling us, this place is CORPORATE, CORPORATE this CORPORATE that.

When this establishment is supposedly an animal emergency hospital!!!!!

Excuse my frustration please but understand, I came in with my 9 month puppy Labsky, his name is Koko. He’s the sweetest most playful and happiest boy. We came in to Mr. Toledos clinic on February 16th, after Koko suffered an accident (broken arm), automatically my wife and I were scared, we were shocked, we were in a state of panic. We just want to do the best for our dog as quickly and efficiently possible.

He’s like our baby boy right? So we’re putting our faith in this place. I didn’t get there any later than 20 min after the accident happened. They were great they were friendly. We get there I’m carrying my Koko, obviously I’m just a first time doggie father looking for a professional “compass” to guide us in the right direction.

But we should’ve known better after we got the bill, the list of fees it were endless! but what was I going to do drive my boy all around town looking for a place that can help in such a crucial situation?, of course not nobody in their right mind would do that!! And they know that! Everybody knows that. But I’m in a very difficult situation financially.

So I haggled and I negotiated the best I could while holding my emotions together, & as I was wondering to myself wow this is a LIVING, LOVING & LOYAL life we are negotiating about! I’m asking for some help I’m not asking for free service. I’m willing to get on a payment plan. I’m doing and saying all I can for Koko to get the help he deserves.

But this place made me feel like man’s/ woman’s best friend dog, cat, bird, fish; fur, feathers, scales mammals or reptiles, this place is more cold blooded then I ever imagined.

An emergency animal hospital should be treated as such, an EMERGENCY ANIMAL HOSPITAL!!!

Not a CORPORATION.

This business doesn’t allow their reviewers to post any pictures but I’ll be posting them on my social media.

Homestead Animal Hospital gets a 10/10 from me and my boy Copper for sure! Copper actually enjoys going to see his doctor’s and him and I greatly enjoy the friendly atmosphere we experience when he has his appointments. All the employees go above and beyond with treating all clients with happiness, gratitude, and sincerity when the time is needed. I wouldn’t trust anyone else with fur boy. H.A.H. Has my respect no doubt. 💙👍
Staff is always very nice and accommodating.  Dr T is the best!
Incredible experience and service! Viviana is very friendly and kind, and the doctor gave us the right explanation and helped us with our dog.

When someone like Dr. Ortega looks at your babies with kindness, knowledge, and genuine love, it creates a deep sense of trust and peace. As a doggie parent, there’s nothing more reassuring than knowing my babies are truly cared for — not just medically, but emotionally too. Thank you 😊 …

My long-time vet retired, so I did my research and landed on Dr. Toledo at Homestead Animal Hospital. Honestly, the dog tells the story better than I can. My 5lb Morkie, Logan, is usually hesitant at the clinic, but he walked right into this office without any fear. To me, that’s a clear sign of a clean, high-quality environment.

The office staff is professional and kept me informed the whole time. It’s also very obvious that Dr. Toledo and his assistant, Ish, actually love animals and enjoy their jobs—they are top-notch. Logan had pre-screening blood work done for an upcoming dental cleaning and some extractions. I’m confident he’s getting exactly the care he needs without being overcharged. If you’re looking for an honest vet who puts the animal first, this is the place.
I live Dr. Toledo but ever since they change staff they have been the worst.
The doctor completely answered all my questions , explained everything, and did a complete evaluation of my pet not just a quick scan.  Very pleased
Warm and friendly, competent professionals.  Who could ask for more?
love them

Very disappointing.  Will not use them again.  Took a stray kitten in that required treatment  Sadly the kitten didn't respond & continued to deteriorate, became extremely ill.  I took the kitten back to be euthanized (kitten had a severe respiratory infection, intestinal parasites, & sarcoptic mange; at 4 months weighed 2.5 lbs. & lost more weight after treatment, lethargic & not eating).  It was obvious the kitten was not going to survive (again this is after preliminary treatment).  Saw Dr. Salazar on 2nd visit to have kitten euthanized.  Dr. Salazar suggested I give the original treatment 'time' to work as it had only been a couple of days.  It was actually over a week, he was looking at the wrong date in the records.  His suggested fluids & hospitalization!  FLUIDS!  For a dying kitten!  But a nice big bill for them! No treatment for any of it's medical issues, just fluids.  Shameful!  Called my regular vet who, bless them, came to my house to put this poor baby out of its misery
Thank you for taking the time to rate us, Marieta! We are delighted that you had a great experience with Homestead Animal Hospital .
Great service and customer service they take you pet with a lots of love

My pet Lola had surgery yesterday with Dr. Toledo. He's a very good veterinarian, very caring and attentive to our pet and to us. I recommend him 100%. The front desk staff were very attentive, and the veterinary assistants were very caring; overall, the service from everyone was excellent. My pet has been a patient at this clinic for over two years, and I wouldn't change a thing.
Thanks to the Doctor and his assistant, my little one has been better since Friday and we can finally sleep through the night 🤭. …

We have been taking all of our pets to HAH for about 15yrs now.  Although we miss Dr. Greene this time we saw Dr. Ortega and were very pleased with the care she gave our new dog. The doctors are all great & the staff is always very friendly & professional.  We have used the boarding services as well & always felt our pets were safe and well cared for.  Friends & family that we’ve recommended have become clients & are very happy as well.  Highly recommend!
Love the place, very attentive to your pets and the staff is great
Your feedback is highly appreciated, Dennis. Thank you so much for the review!
Hi, John. We appreciate the rating. So glad we could provide you with a positive experience at Homestead Animal Hospital!
Hi, Romy. Great to hear that you had a good experience at Homestead Animal Hospital. We really appreciate you taking the time to share!
Thank you so much for sharing your great experience with us, Ramon !
Thank you for taking the time to rate us, Michelle! We are delighted that you had a great experience with Homestead Animal Hospital .

It wasn't so good. Went to refill a prescription for my pet, they didn't give it to me, because I was obligated to do blood test, before to add any refill.  Front desk and the vet technician,  were very nice. Dr wasn't care about my refill and my pet treatment  , I was running out for the pill, and he insisted to do the test . I declined it and didn't give the prescription.  I paid the visit for a NO refill.
Went to other vet clinic, and they gave me the prescription immediately,  they were very concern about my pet necessity.
I am a client for Homestead animal hospital since 2012 . Never happened this before.

Used to be a great veterinarian office, it’s a shame their service has gone down. My first time going there a few months ago and they didn’t have the antibiotics my dog needed for his ear infection after they already did the entire checkup up. I had to drive up to another clinic to for them to finish this clinics work. I try to give them the benefit of the doubt and try to walk in another day and get turned away because they were “full of appointments for the day”. I understand if I was coming for an annual or something that can be planned but are we supposed to schedule when our dog gets sick?
Great people, excellent service. They saved my dogs life and I’m eternally grateful and thankful
Hi, D. Great to hear that you had a good experience at Homestead Animal Hospital. We really appreciate you taking the time to share!

The worst experience in my life. I brought my 12 year old Maltese in and Dr Salazar took blood work and never touch my Snoopy during the exam. He decided that Snoopy had Kidney issues and put him on a special Hill Science Diet diet. Recommended his teeth be cleaned and gave me an estimate of $500 and called me after he had the dog under anesthesia to tell me they want to pull 13 teeth. $1300 added $800 to my bill. If that was not bad enough never came out to talk to me about the surgery or the findings as to kidney stones he mention based on the blood work. This Dr gets the Worst Dr on the Planet award. Make sure you do not let your animal be seen by Dr Salazar. I will say the hospital administration is trying to work with me to save my Snoopy who is NOT OK. Im Praying Dr Toledo can help my poor dog who was playful and only need his Rabie Shot updated. At 12 years old question weather a 3 year Rabie Shot was necessary.
I've had to make several visits to this clinic for my cat Dante. The service has been quick and efficient. The attentive care and appointments with Dr. Salazar have been excellent.
Thank you so much for sharing your great experience with us, Michele !
Excellent

I never write reviews but for this place I had to. I went to other vets in Miami and none of them give the quality of care as HAH. My dog has always had allergy issues and other issues since he was a puppy. Other clinics would treat the symptoms and run the bill up to the point it was just insulting. And never answer my questions and keep me confused. And symptoms never went away. I brought him to HAH and my first visit the doctor spend FORTY FIVE minutes addressing every concern, showed me what and how to take care of his issues, spoke clearly and intelligently made sure I left confident and happy. The other doctor recommended and performed a surgery that I didnt know he needed (ignored by the other clinics) that Imo saved him from possibly dying. They are ON TOP of everything and actually CARE. My dog runs to the staff and kisses them every visit. My dog LOVES this vet office he doesnt get nervous going. The staff is absolutely incredible, and intelligent as much as the doctors they let you call anytime with questions and answer everything you ask.  My dog is now perfectly healthy and happy and I have them all to thank! Truly a 5 star office you can count on and trust with your pets!
Thank you for taking the time to rate us, Vicky! We are delighted that you had a great experience with Homestead Animal Hospital .
It has been 10 years since I started using HAH boarding facility for my Layla. It has always been a wonderful place to leave her while we go on vacation.
Great service and very friendly staff. Only thing from keeping this place from 5 stars in the need for an interior remodel.

Although my need for the services with HAH was not a pleasant one (had to euthanize my Lab) the overall experience from beginning to 'end' , was what made the situation more bearable. From speaking with Crystal at the front desk, and eventually with the attending Vet, Dr. Ortega.

Crystal was very courteous, helpful as well as understanding. Dr. Ortega had one of the better 'veterinary bedside manners' I recall from dealing with some local vets. She was patient in explaining the impending procedure to my 'boy'. Clearly answered the questions I had, and demonstrated empathy. She offered me as much time as I needed to say goodbye to my friend.

Overall, I had a very positive experience with Dr. Ortega and Homestead Animal Hospital.
Hi, Jael. Great to hear that you had a good experience at Homestead Animal Hospital. We really appreciate you taking the time to share!
Thank you so much for sharing your great experience with us, Miguel !
As it's been for years, Dr. Toledo is the most caring and thorough veterinarian I know. He has treated my different dachshunds for 23 yeats.
It takes your lifetime to be assisted.
Thank you for taking the time to rate us, Vanessa! We are delighted that you had a great experience with Homestead Animal Hospital .
Your feedback is highly appreciated, Yohanka. Thank you so much for the review!

Homestead Animal Hospital and its employees are amazing. I called the last minute for a dog check-up (lost dog showed up at our house), the lady on the phone was very pleasant and managed to squeeze us in for a visit. When we arrived, we were welcomed, and employees were nothing but assertive and friendly. They scanned the dog for the chip, managed to contact the owner, and provided me with all the information needed regarding the process.
While I was waiting, I noticed that the place was clean, pets were seen quickly, and once "my" dog pooped- they provided a new pad and took him to wash his paws.

If you are wondering where to take your pet, I wouldn't think twice about this place.

I was passing by my mother’s house when my  puppy had an anaphylactic vaccine reaction we drove to the nearest animal clinic. The nurses and the doctor did an amazing job at helping my pup, Ozzy was in amazing hands, not only they helped him but they comforted me since I couldn’t stop crying but my family and I are very very blessed on how fast they reacted and were able to help our Ozzy, the doctor took his time to explain to me what had happened, everything they did and will do and the steps for the future, we couldn’t have been more grateful. I cannot say how lucky we were that Ozzy fell into these amazing hands! And I also made the transfer to make this our official clinic as well.

What can you say about a veterinarian that saves the life of one of your family members? In moments of dire need you can only wish that you find a vet that is experienced, knowledgable and thorough. Well, Dr. Ortega was THE vet to go to for Mila our beloved 10 y/o female Maltese.

I haven't needed an animal hospital in Homestead until recently and since it was urgent I found them through a google search. Luckily they were also the closest distance from my residence. Dr. Ortega and the incredibly friendly and competent staff at Homestead Animal Hospital saved our sweet girl's life from severe acute pancreatitis. They got us in the same day and by the time I left, an action plan was in place to do what was needed over a couple of days and a great follow up plan to prevent a relapse.

Very highly recommended. After having companion animals for over 30 years in three different counties in South Florida (and countless different vets) I am left extremely impressed and grateful.

Thank you so much Dr. Ortega & Staff!
They're so good with my baby Max

Today we visited the clinic for the first time to have my dog's annual vaccinations. We received exceptional care from Dr. Ortega and the technicians❤️ they are super loving and concerned. Thank you!!!!!!!!
My former Vet in Homestead closed down. I was lucky to get an appointment. The front desk, Vet assistants, and Dr. were great!  All my puppy's issues were addressed.  My experience was excellent!
Homestead animal hospital has been amazing since I first came to them couple years ago, they care and will go over each process with patience. Thank you for always taking care of my fur babies!
The veterinarians are so professional; they completely cured my princess's allergies. They are the best!
In my experience, the attention and dedication I received from Nala was excellent. I honestly can't say anything bad about it at the moment. Thank you so much.

I have been with this clinic for over  14yrs.  Within the last 2yrs things have changed alot.  The only veterinarian I trusted was Dr Greene and now he is gone.  I do like Dr Ortega, she seems fair.  I don't like the idea that the veterinarians are always trying to push unnecessary test on our dogs.  Every appointment they ask you bring a fecial sample so they can test it.  But sometimes it has only been 2 months since the last fecial test.  I realize they have to make money but at this point I feel like they are taking advantage of our love for our dogs.  Not feel comfortable there any more.
Frances
Professional, loving staff.  They take excellent care of my anxious dog.  They send me updates on her health and welfare throughout her stay.
They are always  great with my dog! They really care for your fur baby! Friendly and good with all the animal's.
Dr Toledo and his team are the best. Thank you for taking such good care of my fur baby Charlie. Vivi thank you for your kindness.

Hoping my 1.9 millions views can get a clear view of the poor compassion service they provide.
I was invited personally by Zach Finn staff to Dr Green memorial. Now, after 11 years of trust and ongoing expensive relationship with this Vet Clinic , Zach Finn mailed me a letter instead of a courtesy call. Its clear Dr Toledo is leading him away from everything Dr Green standed for.
We missed him dearly, this would never happen if he was alive.
Please know Zach that your response was poorly coordinated. I would never let my dog return to this establishment after what your lead vet, Dr Toledo, commented on us. His comments made a lot of damage to our family. Its clear he got some of the staff intimidated. But he doesn't intimidate me.
They are very good people, keep the place clean and are very nice and helpful
